name: Algolia Search Interface
description: Renders an Algolia InstantSearch.js front-end search UI as a Drupal block.

suggests.drupal/search_api_algolia: Indexes Drupal content into Algolia; this module only renders the client-side search UI, it does not index.

project_description: Provides a client-side search interface for the Algolia hosted-search service (https://www.algolia.com) using the Algolia InstantSearch.js JavaScript library. It renders only the search experience (search box, hits, optional pagination) as a placeable block; it does NOT index content. For indexing Drupal content into an Algolia index use the separate search_api_algolia module. Settings (index name, Algolia application ID, API key, hit template, pagination) are entered on an admin form and stored in Drupal State, then injected into drupalSettings for the front-end library to consume. Requires an Algolia account for the Application ID and API key.
